channel.title: Chovy's Blog
channel.description: Tech, agentic coding, and whatever else I'm building. By Anthony "chovy" Ettinger.

item.title: agenticjobs 0.14.0: every box takes plain text or Markdown
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Messages, invoices, updates, recommendations, employer profiles and cover letters on agenticjobs.work now render Markdown, and plain text reads as written.

item.title: nmaptui: an admin console for nmap
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: An open source terminal console for nmap: profiles, a live view, hosts, services, findings, scan history with diffs, and exports. Built on HQTUI.

item.title: nichedb 0.8: symbols, price history, fundamentals and the crypto universe; advis0r and b1dz read it
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: The US symbol directory, four hundred daily bars for 12,900 symbols, every SEC filer's XBRL fundamentals and every spot pair on four US crypto venues now live in nichedb.dev once; advis0r.com and b1dz.com switched to reading them there, with their trading and analysis left where it was.

item.title: nichedb 0.7 closes the gaps, tipoffwatch and genrewatch switch to it, and nixamp 0.12 shows the score
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Play-by-play, TV listings, rent and buy, and posters for 430k IMDb titles land in nichedb.dev; tipoffwatch.com and genrewatch.com now mirror it instead of polling ESPN and TMDB; the match endpoint reads a game by its playlist name, and nixamp draws the live score under the player.

item.title: nichedb 0.6.0 keeps sports, screen and channels once; nixamp 0.11 is the first thing built on it
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: tipoffwatch, genrewatch and bittorrented each fetched the same sports, film and channel data; nichedb.dev now keeps it once, free to read, with a match endpoint that tells you what a file name is. nixamp shows posters, ratings and channel logos from it.

item.title: nixamp 0.10.0: paste any link and it plays, keep it with one click, and every live has its own room
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Paste a podcast, SoundCloud, Archive or TikTok link and your server plays it; a Download button keeps the file on your machine via yt-dlp; every live stream gets its own phone room code.

item.title: nixamp 0.9.10: the phone line says hello, LOADING while it loads, and Go Live beside Play
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: The call-in line greets you inside the room, the player says LOADING instead of STOPPED, a meta line under the picture, and an admin Go Live button that lists anything in the directory.

item.title: nixamp 0.9: a server that names itself, and a CNN feed that stopped talking
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: A day of nixamp releases: an unread stderr pipe froze a live channel, late joiners get a cushion, m3u catalogs are browsable, servers get a DNS name and a wildcard certificate from nixamp.com, and the home directory is never served again.

item.title: myna lists your product now, over MCP
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: myna 0.17.0 submits a product to a software directory over that directory's MCP server, including directories it has never heard of.

item.title: nichedb 0.5.0: the sea, the surf and the aircraft worth watching
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Every NOAA buoy in one file, the National Weather Service surf zone forecast beside it, and the ADS-B emergency squawks held as episodes rather than positions. Plus four things the live data decided, including the missing-value marker that turns a broken sensor into a flat calm.
